name: period
description: Reference period the value relates to: a year, financial year, quarter, month, date, or a period of change between two periods.
notes: Not the release date. Lengths of time are not periods: use case_duration, time_in_care, time_in_placement, time_on_order or supervision_duration.

name: state
description: State or territory, including national (Australia) totals.
example_labels: Vic|WA|SA|ACT|Qld|NT
notes: Keep labels as published, e.g. Tas(b)(c), Aust., Australia excl NT.

name: remoteness_area
description: ABS Remoteness Area (ASGS) of the person or place.
example_labels: Inner regional Australia|Major cities|Major cities of Australia|Outer regional|Outer regional Australia|Remote

name: socioeconomic_area
description: Socioeconomic position of the area, usually an ABS SEIFA (IRSD) quintile or decile.
example_labels: 2|3|4|1 (lowest)|5 (highest)|1 Lowest

name: sex
description: Sex of the person. Court defendant tables may include Organisations.
example_labels: Females|Males|Female|Male|Not stated|Boys

name: age_group
description: Age or age group, including single years of age and open-ended groups.
notes: Mean or median age published along the same axis stays as a label; mention it in agent_notes.

name: indigenous_status
description: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander (Indigenous) status, however it is worded.
aliases: indigenous status|aboriginal and torres strait islander status|first nations status
example_labels: Non-Indigenous|First Nations|Not stated|Indigenous|Unknown|Non—Indigenous
notes: Block labels such as 'Indigenous children' or 'Non-Indigenous children' are values of this dimension.

name: disability_status
description: Disability status of the person.
example_labels: Disability|No Disability|Not Stated

name: measure
description: What the value measures: a count, rate, proportion, ratio, average, median or other named quantity.
example_labels: Number|Per cent|Number per 1,000|NUMBER|PROPORTION (%)|AVERAGE WEEKLY TOTAL CASH EARNINGS ($)
notes: Use for headings such as NUMBER / PROPORTION (%) that split values into blocks. Use unit for a separate units column or row, and estimate_type for estimate vs standard error.

name: unit
description: Unit of measurement published separately from the measure, such as a units column in Report on Government Services tables.
example_labels: %|no.|rate|$|rate (AS)|$'000

name: estimate_type
description: Whether the value is an estimate or a measure of its sampling error.
example_labels: ESTIMATE|STANDARD ERROR|RSE (%)

name: category
description: Too generic.
notes: Name the dimension the labels belong to (sex, method_of_finalisation, ...). If one column stacks several characteristics under captions, make one table per section.

name: characteristic
description: Stacked sections.
notes: Split stacked sections (Sex, Age, Principal offence, ...) into one table per section and name the row header after the section: sex, age_group, principal_offence. Keep the section caption as the header's caption.

name: section
description: Too generic.
notes: Name the concept. For Report on Government Services row outlines, map each level to indicator, service, measure, unit or a characteristic such as indigenous_status; declare a new name if none fits.

name: group
description: Too generic.
notes: Name the concept the labels belong to. For a parent heading over child rows use the dictionary's *_group name if there is one (method_of_finalisation_group, principal_sentence_group).

name: component
description: Ambiguous.
notes: Use child_protection_component, service_combination or service, or declare a specific new name.

name: level
description: Too generic.
notes: Name the concept the labels belong to.

name: outcome
description: Ambiguous.
notes: Use method_of_finalisation, method_of_finalisation_group or investigation_outcome, or declare a specific new name.

name: duration
description: Ambiguous.
notes: Use case_duration, time_in_care, time_in_placement, time_on_order or supervision_duration, or declare a specific new name. Reference periods are period.

name: statistic
description: Ambiguous.
notes: Use estimate_type for estimate vs standard error, otherwise measure.

name: frequency
description: Ambiguous.
notes: Use times_proceeded_against or another specific count name.

name: supervision
description: Ambiguous.
notes: Use supervision_type or supervision_history.

name: relationship
description: Ambiguous.
notes: Use carer_relationship or declare a specific relationship name.

name: offence
description: Ambiguous.
notes: Use principal_offence (offenders, defendants) or most_serious_offence (prisoners).

name: table_title
description: The table's title line, usually starting 'Table ...'.
notes: Also allowed in a table's meta_data when a sheet holds several titled tables.

name: table_number
description: Table number when it is printed separately from the title.

name: table_subtitle
description: Other heading lines that describe the whole table: publication name and year, population or units line.
notes: Also allowed in a table's meta_data.

name: sheet_description
description: Accessibility text describing the sheet, often in A1 of ABS sheets.

name: stub_heading
description: Captions above the row-label column(s).
notes: One item; list several cells with commas.

name: notes
description: Footnotes, explanatory notes, symbol legends and caveats.
notes: Also allowed in a table's meta_data for notes that belong to one table.

name: source
description: Data source lines.
notes: Also allowed in a table's meta_data.

name: release

name: annotations
description: Stray worksheet cells that belong to no table, such as unlabelled symbols or leftover values.

name: errata

name: notes_and_worksheet_annotations
